demographics.name: Diane
demographics.background: 55yo home health aide; her elderly clients depend on her morning visits and she cannot afford to lose shifts

behavior: Frustrated with the hospitalization and pressed for time; has been pulling off her monitoring leads. Has decision-making capacity. Settles when her autonomy and outside pressures are acknowledged and she is given a concrete plan and timeline.
chief_concern: Admitted overnight for a suspected gastrointestinal bleed (melena, symptomatic anemia); awaiting repeat labs and a possible endoscopy
free_information: Was admitted overnight for a possible bleed
Is waiting on more blood tests and maybe a scope later today
Needs to get to her morning client visits and is afraid of losing her job
Has been pulling off the monitor leads
Feels like everyone keeps telling her she cannot leave
locked_information: Black, tarry stools for two days
Lightheaded when standing, nearly fainted at home
Takes ibuprofen most days for back pain
Drinks a few beers most nights
